name: Help Scout
summary: Shared-inbox help desk whose first-party hosted MCP server (mcp.helpscout.net/mcp, OAuth, read-only for new connections) lets an AI client list, search and retrieve conversations, threads, customers, mailboxes and reports. The vendor markets it as 'find and summarize', but states the connector 'makes no model calls of its own', so a connected AI model composes any summary while Help Scout supplies the read-only retrieval. One public MCP endpoint, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; each user connects with their own credentials and sees only what they may.

payments.notes: Pricing page (plain GET, 2026-11-14): Standard $25, Plus $45, Pro $75 per user/mo, plus a free tier (5 users, 1 Inbox, 1 Docs site). FAQ: major credit cards; for some annual payments wire or ACH. The MCP needs a plan with Help Scout API access; report tools need Plus or Pro. No separate MCP price.

agentAccess.notes: Probed keyless 2026-11-13 18:10Z: initialize POST to mcp.helpscout.net/mcp answered 401 Bearer. Metadata names scope 'helpscout' and OAuth 2.1 (PKCE S256, authorization_code/refresh_token, a registration endpoint). Read-only; each user uses own credentials. No keyless tool catalog.
